mechanism: Ranitidine may reduce mefloquine absorption and metabolism through gastric pH elevation and potential CYP3A4 inhibition, while mefloquine can cause CNS effects that may be potentiated by histamine-mediated neural activity changes.
action: Monitor for reduced mefloquine efficacy and CNS adverse effects; consider spacing doses or alternative antimalarial if CNS symptoms emerge; ensure adequate mefloquine levels with serum monitoring if available.
